text.text: The Sega CD was a CD-ROM expansion released for the Sega Genesis in 1991. It increased storage capacity and added features including CD-quality audio, animated sequences, and additional graphics capabilities. The system supported games that used the larger capacity of optical media, including Sonic CD, Lunar: The Silver Star, Snatcher, and Final Fight CD. The Sega CD was part of Sega's early effort to transition console gaming toward CD-based formats.
